title: Norman Granz's JATP tours
summary: Young did about three Jazz at the Philharmonic tours, only in the US and Canada.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: I was just tied up enough not to be able to do that thing, you know. And then Norman Granz would come through, and I'd try to keep myself free that I could go on some of those things with Norman. I did do several -- about three of those tours with Norman.
Were they all in the United States or did you go (unintelligible)?
No, I never went to -- I never went anywhere but the United States and Canada with Norman. I never did make any of the European tours.
He wasn't going to Europe towards the beginning.
Not when I went him he wasn't.
It was later on (inaudible). of course, in he started taking things to Europe.
